compiled_evidence.claim: Complete final sm86 SASS dump in bounded chunks, including all embedded kernel variants; source width/dispatch selection determines which variants are selected, and the cited bodies show their row/nonzero loops, arithmetic and stores.

primary_quality_check.method: Read all ten findings and evidence claims. Independently inspect sample complete relevant source/build, both-level MPI/GPU partition coverage and CSR offsets, complete prepareGpu and captureSpmv helpers, full timed OpenMP worker, full seven-way launch dispatcher and called long-row stub, and complete sm86 long-row kernel including row/nonzero backedges, reduction helpers and store. Confirm bounded batch and remainder graph node counts sum to iterations, with every partition synchronized before time end. Other selectable device variants and other IDs inspected by Luna.
